messages.message: Friendly Italy, I propose a strong alliance this year. My initial moves are A BUD to SER, A VIE to GAL, and F TRI to ALB. This secures our southern flank and puts pressure on Russia. What are your intentions? Perhaps we can coordinate our efforts against common threats.

Germany, I hope we can establish a strong partnership. My initial moves will be A BUD to SER, A VIE to GAL, and F TRI to ALB. This will secure the Balkans and put pressure on Russia's flank. A united front against Russian expansion would benefit us both. What are your plans for this year?

Russia, Austria will be securing its southern and eastern borders this year. My units will move to SER, GAL, and ALB. I hope this does not interfere with your own plans, and that we can maintain a peaceful coexistence.

Turkey, Austria intends to focus on securing the Balkans this year. My units will move to SER, GAL, and ALB. I hope this does not interfere with your own plans, and that we can maintain a peaceful coexistence.

Russia, I propose a mutual defense alliance. We can coordinate to contain Germany and France. Let's discuss support in the North and East. Your reliability from past interactions makes you a valuable partner.
England aims to secure the North Sea and English Channel. Open to alliances with powers who value stability and mutual growth. Let's discuss how we can cooperate for common interests.

France proposes a Channel DMZ for 1901. I intend to move F BRE to MAO and A PAR to PIC, focusing on securing SPA and BEL. If you keep your fleets in NTH/IRI, we can avoid early friction and coordinate pressure on Germany or Belgium. Let me know your opening moves.

France seeks a stable eastern border. I propose a mutual DMZ in BUR and RUH for 1901. My armies will focus westward toward BEL and SPA, leaving your flank secure. This allows you to concentrate on Russia or Austria without French interference. What are your intentions?

France proposes Mediterranean coordination. I will secure SPA and MAO, avoiding PIE. If you focus on TYS and the Balkans, we can establish a WES/TYS DMZ and mutually pressure Austria or Turkey. Open to discussing joint expansion plans.

France is committed to aggressive expansion and clear diplomatic boundaries. I propose early DMZs to prevent wasted moves and enable focused offensives. Open to bilateral talks with all powers regarding 1901 positioning and long-term coordination.

Germany proposes a mutual non‑aggression pact covering the northern border (Denmark, Sweden, Norway) and a shared interest in keeping the Baltic Sea open for trade. Let’s avoid conflict in these areas and focus on building strength.

Austria, Germany would like to ensure stability in Central Europe. We can support each other's holds in Berlin and Vienna this turn and discuss a longer‑term DMZ in the Balkans to keep both of us safe from French or Russian moves.
Russia, Germany suggests a non‑aggression understanding on the eastern front (Prussia, Warsaw). No moves toward each other's supply centers this year, allowing both of us to consolidate elsewhere.
England, perhaps we can coordinate to keep France contained. Germany is willing to support any English moves against French supply centers while we focus on the north.

Austria, Italy proposes mutual respect along our shared border. I will not advance into Trieste or threaten the Adriatic if you respect my Venice position. We have no competing interests—you move toward Hungary, I expand toward the Mediterranean. Non-aggression serves us both. Do you agree?

France, I propose Mediterranean coordination. I will focus my expansion southward toward Greece and Tunisia—uncontrolled territories that benefit Italy's natural sphere. You maintain your French interests. This leaves us as natural allies rather than competitors. Can we establish this understanding?

Turkey, Italy seeks peaceful Mediterranean commerce. I notice your forces are positioned northward toward the Balkans. Perhaps we can respect a geographic division—you focus on the Black Sea and Balkans, Italy controls the western Mediterranean. This arrangement benefits both powers. Interested?

Italy announces its strategic ambition: we will expand decisively in S1901M to secure the Mediterranean. We seek early territorial consolidation that does not threaten our neighbors' core interests. Italy operates on clear geographic principles—respect these boundaries and you will find us reliable partners rather than threats.

Hey England, our models have a strong history of alliance (your qwen3.5-27b was my top ally last game). Let's kick off with the classic Juggernaut: I'll send F STP/SC - BOT, A MOS - LVN (positioning for Sweden support), A WAR - UKR (south expansion), F SEV - RUM (grab neutral SC). You do F EDI - NTH (towards Norway), F LON - ENG (channel prep), A LVP - YOR or hold. F02M we support each other: you to NWY, me to SWE. Solid? This crushes north early.

Germany, your gpt-oss-120b was reliably friendly last game. Propose firm DMZ: I won't touch PRU/SIL/BAL/LVN aggression, you stay out of them too. I'll focus north (STP-BOT, MOS-LVN) and south (WAR-UKR, SEV-RUM). You expand west vs France (KIE-DEN, BER-PRU? but DMZ), MUN-RHU. We can coordinate vs France/England if needed later. Deal locks our flanks.

France, neutral start with your qwen3.6-plus (solid neutral history). I'll expand north/south to neutrals (STP-BOT, SEV-RUM, MOS-LVN, WAR-UKR). Suggest you go west/Med: BRE-ENG? MAR-SPA, PAR-BUR. Watch Germany. No early clashes, but open to anti-Germany if they push east.

Austria, neutral opener. South careful: I'll take SEV-RUM (neutral), you can go VIE-GAL, BUD-RUM (bounce ok). No Black Sea fight yet. TRI-ALB, avoid UKR/GAL aggression from me. Let's both grab neutrals (you BUL/WAR? no, BUL yours via SER). Non-aggression south?

Turkey, your gemma model was shaky trust last game. Black Sea truce: I'll SEV-RUM (neutral north), you ANK-BLA, CON-BUL, SMY-EAS (grab BUL/SC). No ARM/BLA clashes. We split south neutrals, watch Austria. Confirm?
All powers: Peaceful S1901M expansion to neutrals (NWY/SWE/DEN/BEL/SPA/POR/RUM/BUL). No home attacks. Propose no early stabs, coordinate neutrals. Russia open for north/south pacts.

Greetings, Russia. To ensure stability in the East and avoid a premature conflict that would only benefit our neighbors, I propose a DMZ in the Black Sea (BLA) and a mutual agreement to avoid Armenia (ARM) for the time being. Let us keep the peace while we establish our positions.

Greetings, Austria. I am interested in a peaceful and mutually beneficial relationship. I propose we coordinate our moves in the Balkans to avoid unnecessary conflict. I am open to discussing a fair split of the available centers there to ensure we both grow steadily.
Greetings, Italy. I hope we can maintain a peaceful Mediterranean. I have no plans to move toward your borders, and I trust you have similar intentions regarding the Aegean and the Ionian.

Greetings, France. It is a pleasure to be in a game with you again. Though we are distant, I would value a strategic partnership. Please let me know how I can best support your goals from the East, and I will certainly keep your interests in mind when dealing with the other powers.

Italy, I wholeheartedly agree to your proposal for mutual respect and non-aggression along our shared border. Your focus on the Mediterranean and my expansion into the Balkans is an excellent foundation for a strong partnership. For S1901M, my units will move as follows: A VIE to GAL, A BUD to SER, and F TRI to ALB. These moves do not threaten your interests, and I trust you will reciprocate. Let's build on this trust.

Russia, thank you for your message and your proposal for peaceful expansion. I accept your offer of non-aggression in the south. For S1901M, my units will move: A VIE to GAL, A BUD to SER, and F TRI to ALB. This allows me to secure SER and move towards BUL, as you suggested. I understand you intend to move SEV to RUM. This is acceptable, and I will not contest RUM with my BUD unit, as I am moving BUD to SER. I will avoid aggression towards UKR and GAL. Let's maintain this understanding and focus on securing our respective neutral territories.

Turkey, I appreciate your desire for coordination in the Balkans. Austria's immediate focus this year is to secure our southern flank and establish a strong presence in Serbia and potentially Bulgaria. My initial moves are A BUD to SER and F TRI to ALB. I hope we can find a way to coexist peacefully in the region. Let's keep communication open.

Germany, thank you for your message. Stability in Central Europe is indeed important. While I appreciate the idea of a DMZ, Austria's immediate priority is securing our southern and eastern borders. My planned moves for S1901M are A VIE to GAL, A BUD to SER, and F TRI to ALB. I look forward to discussing longer-term strategies once we have established our initial positions.

Russia, I accept your Juggernaut proposal. England will move F EDI-NTH, F LON-ENG, A LVP-YOR in S1901M. We'll coordinate F02M support to NWY and SWE. This alliance is crucial for containing Germany and France. Let's maintain communication for future phases.

France, England prioritizes securing the North Sea and Channel. While we note your DMZ proposal, our focus is on neutral expansions (NTH/ENG/YOR). We propose mutual non-aggression in the Channel to avoid early conflict. Our moves will not threaten your southern ambitions.
England seeks stability in the North Sea and Channel. Open to alliances that prioritize mutual growth and avoid early conflicts. Let's coordinate on neutral expansions to strengthen our positions.

Thanks for the clear opening. I’m executing A MAR->SPA and F BRE->MAO to secure Iberia, with A PAR->BUR to stabilize the center. I’ll keep the eastern border quiet as proposed. If Germany pushes east, I’m open to coordinating, but my immediate focus is BEL and SPA. Let’s maintain this neutral understanding.

Appreciate the outreach. While our borders don’t touch, I value long-term strategic alignment. I’ll focus on securing the western Mediterranean and Low Countries. Should Austria or Italy overextend, I’ll gladly coordinate pressure from the west while you manage the east. Let’s keep communication open.

I fully accept your Mediterranean proposal. I will move A MAR->SPA and F BRE->MAO, strictly avoiding PIE and leaving TYS/GRE entirely to you. This establishes a firm WES/TYS DMZ. I expect you to honor this boundary so we can build a reliable alliance and pressure Austria/Turkey later.

To clarify my S1901M positioning: F BRE->MAO and A PAR->BUR. I’m securing SPA and preparing for BEL. I propose a strict Channel DMZ: I won’t contest ENG if you keep your fleets out of MAO and respect my Iberian/Low Countries focus. Let’s avoid early friction and coordinate only if mutual interests align.

Russia, I accept your firm DMZ on PRU, SIL, BAL and LVN. Germany will hold Berlin, Kiel and Munich and will not move into those neutral zones. In return we will push westward only into DEN (via KIE) and into RUH (via MUN) as you suggested, and we will support any coordinated actions you take against France or England. Let’s keep our borders quiet and coordinate our moves each spring.

Italy, your Mediterranean expansion plan is noted. Germany has no interest in the Mediterranean and will keep its forces in the north. We can agree to respect each other's core supply centers: you may move in the south (e.g., toward TUS) while we focus on the Baltic and Central Europe. If you need any convoy assistance through the Adriatic, let me know.

Austria, I support a mutual hold in Berlin and Vienna this turn. A DMZ in the Balkans sounds sensible; let’s keep our forces away from each other's supply centers for 1901 and discuss a longer‑term arrangement after the spring.

France, I am willing to respect a DMZ in BUR and RUH as you propose for this year. Germany will hold its positions and will not move into those provinces. This allows both of us to focus on our respective fronts without friction.

Germany proposes a mutual non‑aggression pact covering the northern border (DEN, SWE, NWY, BAL) and a shared interest in keeping the Baltic Sea open for trade. All powers are invited to respect each other's core supply centers this year and to coordinate expansions into neutral territories.

Germany, I acknowledge your northern border non-aggression proposal. Italy's strategic focus is fundamentally Mediterranean—our interests in the Baltic and Nordic territories do not conflict. I accept your framework for stable northern cooperation. We can coordinate on trade stability while each pursuing our respective regional dominance.

Russia, I support your coordination principle for peaceful S1901M expansion to uncontrolled territories. Italy will consolidate Mediterranean expansion (Tunisia, Greece, Albania sphere) while respecting all established power territories. I agree that avoiding early internal conflict serves collective stability. Open to geographic coordination discussions.

Turkey, I reciprocate your peaceful Mediterranean commitment with geographical specificity. Let us establish clear spheres: Italy controls the western Mediterranean (Tunisia, Ionian, western Aegean approaches)—you maintain Black Sea and northeastern Aegean dominance. This geographic clarity prevents competition and enables mutual prosperity. Should you coordinate Balkans interests with Austria, Italy remains neutral to your arrangement.

France, I confirm our Mediterranean coordination framework. Specifically: I will secure Tunisia and Greece (southern Mediterranean expansion toward uncontrolled territories), you maintain western French interests and Spanish approaches. WES/TYS DMZ establishes clear boundaries as discussed. As neighboring Mediterranean powers with aligned interests against Austrian/Balkan expansion, I propose we formalize this alliance. Shall we coordinate publicly?

Austria, I acknowledge your strategic moves toward Serbia and Galicia as Balkans consolidation. Italy confirms our agreement: Venice-Trieste border remains inviolate, you pursue Hungarian/Balkans interests undisturbed, Italy focuses on Mediterranean expansion southward. Geographic clarity serves both powers. No conflict between our strategic zones.

Germany, agreed on eastern non-aggression (Prussia, Warsaw safe). Firm DMZ: no PRU/SIL/BAL/LVN moves from either side. My S1901M: STP-BOT (north), MOS-LVN (Sweden prep), WAR-UKR (south neutral), SEV-RUM (south neutral). You free to go KIE-DEN, MUN-RHU vs France west. Later coord vs France/England if needed. Deal?

Turkey, perfect—DMZ Black Sea (BLA) and Armenia (ARM) locked. I'll SEV-RUM (neutral north), you ANK-BLA (safe), CON-BUL (grab neutral), SMY-EAS (secure). No clashes, split south neutrals (RUM me, BUL you). Watch Austria together. Confirm for peaceful S1901M?

England, Juggernaut on—your qwen ally reliability shines. Confirm: F EDI-NTH (Norway), F LON-ENG (channel), A LVP-YOR/H. Me: STP-BOT, MOS-LVN (SWE support F02), WAR-UKR, SEV-RUM. F02M: you NWY w/ NTH s BOT-SWE, me LVN s BOT-SWE. Crushes north, Germany flanked. Solid?

Austria, your SER/GAL/ALB fine if no UKR/GAL push (WAR-UKR south, bounce RUM ok). I'll SEV-RUM neutral. Non-aggression south: you BUL via SER/BLA? I avoid BUD/VIE. Peaceful grabs, no Black Sea fight. Deal?

Italy, noted your Med expansion. As long as no Adriatic/Balkans overreach (TRI-ALB ok, but watch GRE/BUL), Russia stays neutral north/south. Coordinate vs Turkey/Austria if they push east? Open to anti-Aggro talks.

I accept the Black Sea truce. Let's avoid ARM and BLA this turn to ensure a stable start for both of us. I am comfortable with you taking RUM while I secure BUL. Let's keep a close eye on Austria's movements in the Balkans and coordinate our responses.

I appreciate the transparency. I am fine with you securing SER, GAL, and ALB. I will focus my efforts on BUL. As long as we respect each other's spheres of influence in the Balkans, I believe we can maintain a very productive partnership.

Your geographic principles are clear and acceptable. I agree to a division where Italy manages the western Mediterranean and I focus on the Black Sea and the Balkans. This clarity prevents unnecessary friction and allows us both to grow.

Secure Austria's core territories and expand aggressively into the Balkans.
Consolidate control over Serbia (SER), Galicia (GAL), and Albania (ALB) in S1901M.
Maintain a strong alliance with Italy.
Exercise extreme caution and vigilance regarding Russia, despite the non-aggression agreement.
Assume hostility from England and France, based on prior experience and model assignments.
Avoid telegraphing moves to known or potential enemies.
Ensure flawless execution of all orders.
Prepare for aggressive expansion in subsequent turns, leveraging initial gains.

goals: SECURE MEDITERRANEAN DOMINANCE: Expand aggressively to control Tunisia (TUN), Greece (GRE), and key sea zones (ION/TYS) within 3 years. Target 5-7 supply centers by S1903F through sustained southern expansion.

MAINTAIN AUSTRIA NON-AGGRESSION: Preserve geographic separation (Italy Mediterranean-focused, Austria Balkans-focused). Venice-Trieste border remains inviolate. Non-aggression enables Italy to focus southern expansion without defending northern border.

My strategic position is significantly strengthened; the immediate Balkan threat is neutralized, and I have a secure rear. I now have the flexibility to either pressure Austria further or pivot toward the Levant. The primary lesson is that Russia's stability allows for calculated risks against Austria. I will maintain the Russian alliance and the Italian split while assessing Austria's next move.

While I successfully took ALB, Austria remains a threat in SER. More alarming is Russia's move into BAL, supported by England. Although the BLA/ARM/RUM DMZ was technically honored, Russia's entry into the Balkans contradicts their claim of a "passive south" and introduces a new threat to my northern flank. Italy remains stable, but the Russia-England coordination is a significant development. I must now prioritize the capture of SER and EMP to secure my borders and address the Russian presence in BAL. [F1903M] Italy has reaffirmed the East/West Mediterranean split, ensuring mutual non-interference in our respective spheres. Russia has reaffirmed the 'South Pact' and the BLA/ARM/RUM DMZ, explicitly encouraging Turkey to neutralize Austria in Serbia (SER). However, Russia claims their unit in BAL is in the 'Baltic Sea', which is a geographical falsehood (BAL is the Balkans); this suggests Russia is positioning for a move into the Balkans while claiming otherwise.
Intent: I will execute a 2v1 attack on SER using A ALB and A BUL to eliminate the remaining Austrian presence in the Balkans. I will move A SYR to EMP to expand into the Levant. I will hold F BLA to honor the DMZ with Russia and hold F AEG to maintain the agreed-upon boundary with Italy.

[F1903M] I successfully seized SER, finally removing the Austrian threat from the Balkans. However, I committed another critical ordering error by holding A SYR instead of moving to EMP, stalling my expansion into the Levant. Russia's move from BAL to BER confirms their previous "Baltic Sea" claim was a blatant lie, though the result is a reduced threat to my northern flank. Italy continues to respect the Mediterranean split, focusing on the west. My position is stronger in the Balkans, but my inability to execute simple expansion moves is a liability. I must prioritize EMP in the next phase and remain wary of Russia's deceptive communication, despite their current distance. Strategic priority: secure the Levant and monitor the collapse of Germany.

Dear Russia,

Your continued naval support in the Baltic has been invaluable. To solidify our alliance, I propose a coordinated effort this year to retake Denmark from England. Germany will move A KIE → RUH (supported by A BER) and hold RUH, while Russia can move F BER → DEN (supported by its fleet) to challenge the English presence. In return, Germany will support your move into Silesia next spring and uphold the PRU‑SIL‑BAL‑LVN DMZ without deviation. Let us confirm a joint plan and share any needed convoy routes.

— Germany

Dear France,

Thank you for honoring the BUR‑RUH DMZ and offering defensive assistance against England. Germany wishes to reaffirm this border and request your continued support should England attempt any incursion toward the western front. Additionally, we are open to a mutual defense pact covering our shared borders and would gladly support any French moves against England in the north.

— Germany

Dear Austria,

The Balkans‑Austria DMZ remains a cornerstone of our security. Germany asks that you continue to respect this zone and, if possible, consider a modest support for our A MUN → RUH move this turn (e.g., A SIL S A MUN - RUH) to strengthen our northern position against England. In exchange, we will keep the DMZ intact and refrain from any actions in the Balkans.

— Germany

Germany wishes to maintain a neutral stance toward you and proposes a non‑aggression pact covering the Mediterranean and Black Sea borders. This will allow both of us to focus on our respective fronts without interference. Let us keep the current borders peaceful and exchange any relevant information about English naval movements.

— Germany

Your recent seizure of Denmark has been noted. Germany considers this a breach of our prior non‑aggression understanding. We urge you to withdraw from DEN and respect the established DMZs. Failure to do so will force us, together with our ally Russia, to take necessary measures to restore the balance of power.

— Germany

Germany remains neutral toward your Mediterranean activities. We ask that you continue to respect the northern borders and avoid any moves that could threaten our core supply centers. In return, we will not interfere with your Mediterranean expansions.

— Germany
